concerns.text: The pipeline creates `data/processed/cleaned.parquet` (Task T004) but there is no task that validates this cleaned dataset against the `contracts/cleaned_dataset.schema.yaml` contract. This leaves the cleaned data unverified, violating contract coverage.

Success Criterion SC-005 is marked `[deferred]` in the specification, yet Task T010 explicitly validates the 2‑out‑of‑3 signal rule (SC‑005) as a required check. This creates a mismatch between the spec (deferred) and the implementation (required), introducing an unnecessary requirement.
